locations.note: Chloe Frazer and Nadine Ross drive across the Western Ghats, following towers marked with Ganesh's trident, Shiva's bow and Parashurama's axe while Asav's insurgents hunt them.
The trail leads to the ruins of Halebidu, the later Hoysala capital, where Chloe and Nadine work out that its last emperor laid a false trail and the tusk lies at the older capital.
At Belur, Chloe finds the Tusk of Ganesh, but Asav takes it and leaves her, Nadine and Sam to drown; they escape and chase his bomb train towards the capital.

routes.name: Chloe Frazer and Nadine Ross
routes.note: Across the Western Ghats to the Hoysala ruins at Halebidu and the tusk at Belur.
